Only selected RGB, intrinsics and camera_to_world arrays are decoded. Mechanical/source journals and independent admission receipts are hash-only linkage. Feature functions do not receive measured scene depth, poses, contacts or evaluator labels.

The same 492 integer-center image locations initialize independently after the event in both arms. The unchanged native tracker and A/B helpers use sole reference 0. All 984 tracks / 24,600 rows and all native failures/nulls remain in output; no survivor intersection or reseeding is introduced.
Unavailable own projection nulls B only. Finite off-image projections and the established half-pixel convention remain unchanged. B adds proprioception/calibration and is not RGB-only.

Extraction requires the actual reviewed source binding, matching no-feature preflight, exact clean code/protocol freeze and a separate one-batch review at the fixed unused output path. The current code-only review does not satisfy that execution receipt.

Fresh pixel IDs identify equal image coordinates, not common material points. Empty-hand local co-motion can arise from finger/background patch support; no identity, rigid attachment, holding, classifier or anchor ranking follows.
